user.title: Xiaomi MIoT Camera Setup
user.description:
Select your Xiaomi cloud server region to begin setup.

Note: This integration requires the 'Xiaomi Camera Proxy' Add-on to be installed and running.

auth.title: Xiaomi Account Login
auth.description:
Please login to your Xiaomi account:

Step 1: Open this URL in your browser:
{auth_url}

Step 2: Login with your Xiaomi account and authorize.

Step 3: After authorization, you will see a success page. Set your Home Assistant callback URL in the input box:
{callback_url}

Step 4: Click Jump button to complete authorization automatically.

Alternative: If automatic callback does not work, you can manually copy the code and state values from the redirect page and enter them below.

auth_manual.title: Manual Token Input
auth_manual.description: Enter your Xiaomi OAuth tokens manually.
